Capabilities

Everything finance needs to move invoices with confidence.

A clean operating layer for drafting, validation, exception handling, approvals, and reporting — built with the same calm visual language as your current design.

Fast invoice creation

Create invoices manually, import in bulk, or reuse buyer and seller data without repeating admin work.

Smart validation

Catch missing fields, schema issues, tax mismatches, and approval blockers before they slow the team down.

Approval routing

Move invoices from draft to review to approval with clear ownership, statuses, and audit history.

PEPPOL exchange

Prepare and route compliant e-invoices while keeping delivery status visible to finance and operations.

Reporting dashboard

Track processed invoices, validation pass rate, exception queues, and tax reporting progress from one screen.

Controlled access

Keep company data isolated and give users only the actions they need through role-based permissions.

Create Your Invoice
